tools.name: discover_pages
tools.description: Free 3 times a day per client address (at most 50 pages each), no key needed. Lists the pages of Site A (sitemap, robots.txt or crawl), mapped onto Site B when given. Call it to see which pages a comparison would cover or to pick pairs for urls. Do not call it before start_comparison only to price a

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Free 3 times a day per client address, no key needed. Full-page PNG of one URL at the given viewport width, returned inline when small, else as links.file to fetch with the jobToken. Call it for a one-off look at a page or a mobile-width check. Do not call it for pages a comparison job covers: get_r

tools.name: start_comparison
tools.description: Free up to 10 pages a day per client address, no key needed; sample report: https://difficat.com/agents/sample/report.json. Compares Site A against Site B on page existence, content and visual regression, priced on the pages it compares. Call it for a migration or redesign check: sourceUrl and targe

tools.name: recover_comparison
tools.description: Returns the job or screenshot the payment credential in _meta paid for, with a new jobToken that replaces the old one; or, when the request carries a key and _meta no credential, the latest job that key paid for (no jobToken: the key reads it). Call it when a paid call’s result never arrived. Do not

tools.name: get_comparison
tools.description: Status and progress of a job and, once it is terminal, its summary: passed, failed and issuesBySeverity. To wait for the end, call wait_for_comparison instead. Free.

tools.name: cancel_comparison
tools.description: Stop a running job; the job reports cancelled within a minute, with the pages compared so far in its report. Free.

tools.name: wait_for_comparison
tools.description: Waits until the job reaches a terminal status (completed, failed or cancelled) or timeoutSeconds pass (default 60, at most 300), then answers like get_comparison: status, progress and, once terminal, the summary with passed, failed and issuesBySeverity. A wait that runs out answers status "running";

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: The finished report. Call it first with failedOnly: true: results, total and nextOffset then cover only the pages that failed, while summary still covers every page. Each result is { path, status, failedChecks } by default; responseFormat: "detailed" returns the full per-check fields, diffs and scre

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Fetch one screenshot PNG by filename. Call it when a get_report page result or a capture_screenshot result names a screenshot you want to see; a PNG over the inline cap comes back as links.file to fetch with the jobToken. Free.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: The prepaid balance and the last 20 ledger entries of the key the request carries in its Authorization: Bearer or X-DiffiCat-Key header. Call it to check what a key can still pay for; request_prepaid_key is the way to obtain a key. For a Pro account’s key the balance is 0.00 and allowance (included

tools.name: request_prepaid_key
tools.description: Mints a prepaid key and a Checkout link for a human to pay by card, so later paid calls are debited from its balance instead of challenged. tools.description: Sends one message to the people who run this service: why a price, a payment path or a result did not fit. findings.detail: Description of "get_balance" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: discover_pages, capture_screenshot, start_comparison, get_report · Private data: capture_screenshot, recover_comparison, get_screenshot, request_prepaid_key · Public sink: send_feedback · Destructive: discover_pages, capture_screenshot, start_comparison, recover_comparison, get_balance, send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: discover_pages, capture_screenshot, start_comparison, get_report · Private data: capture_screenshot, recover_comparison, get_screenshot, request_prepaid_key · Public sink: send_feedback · Destructive: discover_pages, capture_screenshot, start_comparison, recover_comparison, get_balance, send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "discover_pages" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
